definitions.text: The small and nearly cubical stone building, toward which all Mohammedans must pray. [Written also kaaba.] a famous black stone said to have been brought from heaven. Before the time of Mohammed, the Caaba was an idolatrous temple, but it has since been the chief sanctuary and object of pilgrimage of the Mohammedan world.
A small cañon; a narrow valley or glen; also, but less frequently, an open valley. [Local, Western U. S.]
A forest composed of stunted trees and thorny bushes, found in areas of small rainfall in Brazil.
